description: This file contains training and evaluation functions for object detection models, including the implementation of training loop (`train_one_epoch`) and evaluation function (`evaluate`). It integrates with external datasets and evaluation tools such as COCO and Panoptic evaluators, and uses utility modules for metrics and reductions.
